paragraphs.source_en: Xaro gave a languid shrug. “As it happens, when I came ashore in your sweet city, I chanced to see upon the riverbank a man who had once been a guest in my manse, a merchant who dealt in rare spices and choice wines. He was naked from the waist up, red and peeling, and seemed to be digging a hole.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Not a hole. A ditch, to bring water from the river to the fields. We mean to plant beans. The beanfields must have water.”
